SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. I, Special Branch
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
File No. S. B. D. 96/7(C)
Date 22 / 12
Dec. 22nd, 1939.

Subject Jack Leicester Hunter alias Jacques Unter.

Made by D.S.I. Hide Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

Jack Leicester Hunter alias Jacques Unter was born at Jassy, Roumania on October 19th, 1895. His mother was a British subject by birth who lost her national status on her marriage to his father a Roumanian named Leonard Unter. In 1916, after her husband's death, his mother was granted British naturalisation papers on which he was included as a minor. He was subsequently notified by the Roumanian Government that he was no longer entitled to Roumanian nationality. Sometime later Jacques Unter's name was changed by Deed Poll to Jack Leicester Hunter.

Hunter has been registered at the British Consulate annually since March 19th, 1923. He is in possession of British passport No. 8091/31 issued at Shanghai, the application for which was guaranteed by Mr. Douglas Alexander Ross who described himself as a merchant of 12 Hankow Road.

According to the China Hong List, from 1925 to 1932, J. L. Hunter was representative of Morreau & Spiegelberg of Manchester, Prescot, Wright & Co. Ltd. of Bradford and George Fraser, Son & Co., Ltd. of Manchester and Bradford. From 1935 to 1937 he was not listed and in 1938 and 1939 he again appears as Exchange & Bill Broker of Room 3, Yokohama Specie Bank Building, 24 The Bund.

（印：FILE C. 29/12.）

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科档案室
档案号 S. B. D. 96/7(C)
日期 12月22日
1939年12月22日。

主题：Jack Leicester Hunter，别名 Jacques Unter。

由特别科督察 Hide 制作，由督察 Crawford 转呈

Jack Leicester Hunter，别名 Jacques Unter，于1895年10月19日出生于罗马尼亚雅西（Jassy）。其母生来即为英国臣民，但因嫁给其父——一名名为 Leonard Unter 的罗马尼亚人——而丧失了国籍身份。1916年，在其丈夫去世后，其母获颁英国归化证书，他作为未成年人被列于其中。随后，他接到罗马尼亚政府通知，称其不再享有罗马尼亚国籍。不久之后，Jacques Unter 通过契据更改姓名为 Jack Leicester Hunter。

自1923年3月19日起，Hunter 每年均在英国领事馆进行登记。他持有在上海签发的英国护照，号码为 8091/31，该护照申请由自称汉口路12号商人的 Douglas Alexander Ross 先生担保。

根据《在华洋行名录》（China Hong List），1925年至1932年间，J. L. Hunter 是曼彻斯特 Morreau & Spiegelberg 公司、布拉德福德 Prescot, Wright & Co. Ltd. 公司以及曼彻斯特和布拉德福德 George Fraser, Son & Co., Ltd. 公司的代表。1935年至1937年间，名录中未列出其名，而在1938年和1939年，他再次出现，身份为外滩24号横滨正金银行大楼3室的汇兑与票据经纪人。

（印：档案 C. 29/12。）
